children.key: After landing on the Gegno planet "Tschyss", you refuel your ship. Before you take off again, an excited Gegno approaches you. You don't understand his language, but through gestures and a star map, he makes it clear... enemy ships have appeared in the southwestern Gegno sector. He warns you to be careful. You nod, unsure what awaits you. The sector might be dangerous, but something about the Gegno's urgency makes you curious. Maybe you should investigate that area.

values: You have entered the Zaron system. This must be the center of the Gegno pirate threat you've encountered in the previous systems. Boarding these pirates might bring unexpected wealth!

children.key: A look at your long range friend/foe identifier shows that you can land on all Gegno planets now. The Gegno seem to register your fight against the pirate threat.
After comparing all ships engraved on the 8 Gegno Licenses plates, you've looted so far, with the Gegno ships you have seen in their space, it seems you collected all licenses!

name: gegno.pirates complete
displayName: Travel to a hidden Gegno system
description: You received a star map with an additional system not found in your own celestial database. Find out what is there.

children.key: After refuelling you notice a Gegno starring at you and your ship. The eye contact brings motion into his legs, he approaches and hands over a small star map with a marked system. You examine the star map and when you look up again the Gegno already disappeared. The map shows a marked system you don't know. Maybe you should go there and find out what's there.
You reached <destination>. This planet has an outfitter and a shipyard which sell all equipment the Gegno can offer. Time to go shopping!
